note: Visitors start at their hotel. The family’s outing is the museum, with a post office and movie theater located nearby. Find the bus stop for that outing. A clearly announced later journey connects the hotel, taxi and airport; airplane is retrieved as the reason for this travel point. Keep post office, movie theater and museum visually distinctive. The airport trip is a separate episode. No borrowing untaught get on/off to assess this lesson.

lesson.title: 6.4 More Places to Visit
lesson.unit_outcome: Name places and transport, explain a current destination, complete a trip, follow directions, ask for help, choose a service and check its times.
lesson.goal: Use the destination question with six new venues and travel points.
